peaceful.name: Peaceful
peaceful.desc:
Enemies only attack if provoked, and you can talk to them in battle.
Nobody in the party dies for good.

roguelite.name: Roguelike
roguelite.desc:
Em and Bubba get back up after every defeat.
Other party members die for good.

hardcore.name: Hardcore
hardcore.desc:
Limbs can be cut off.
Em and Bubba keep their vital organs and always get back up.
Other party members die for good.

blood_and_oil.name: Blood and Oil
blood_and_oil.desc:
Limbs can be cut off and nobody is protected.
If Bubba dies he is gone for the rest of the story.
If Em dies you give up, or she rises again somewhere in Europe.
Other party members die for good.

vehicleBroom.name: Flying broom
vehicleBroom.desc: A broom. Flies over walls, water and cliffs.

vehicleCar.name: Car
vehicleCar.desc: A car. Fast on open ground, uses fuel.

vehicleCamper.name: Camper
vehicleCamper.desc: A van you can live in, with a bed and a stove.

vehicleBoat.name: Boat
vehicleBoat.desc: An inflatable dinghy. Free to run, water only.

vehicleBike.name: Bike
vehicleBike.desc: A bicycle. No fuel, no upkeep.

vehicleStarship.name: Starship
vehicleStarship.desc: A spaceship. Can't refuel at road pumps.

originDeserter.name: Deserter
originDeserter.desc: Choose a faction you deserted from: begin with [40 of its troops], but [hated] by it (and its parent faction).

originAugmented.name: Augmented
originAugmented.desc: You met at the same clinic. Everyone starts with [two or three augments].

originFactionLeader.name: Faction Leader
originFactionLeader.desc: Choose a faction and begin in command of [40 of its troops], in [good standing] with it (and its parent faction), with [two weeks of upkeep money].

originWarlord.name: Independent Warlord
originWarlord.desc: Begin in command of [40 troops] drawn from random factions, loyal to no one, with enough money to cover [two weeks of their upkeep].

originGoblin.name: Goblin Mode
originGoblin.desc: Your whole party are [goblins]. Begin in a place of your choice, but only among the [places the Goblin Horde holds] when the game starts.

originGoblinHorde.name: Goblin Horde
originGoblinHorde.desc: Horde goblins. Start in a Horde-held place, commanding [{count} Goblin Horde troops] with [two weeks of their upkeep]. Welcome with the Horde, [hated by every power at war with it].

originCrash.name: Crash Landed
originCrash.desc: Begin [stranded on a random planet] in an uncharted galaxy, ship [damaged], nearly out of fuel and with [no jump charges] left.

originArtifact.name: Artifact Heir
originArtifact.desc: Inherit one of the world's [ancient artifacts], chosen at random, along with its history.

originCeo.name: CEO
originCeo.desc: Start rich: [€1,000,000] in cash and an [80% controlling stake in LimeCorp], at its headquarters.

originBunker.name: Bunker
originBunker.desc: Wake up in a [stocked loot cellar] under a random overland biome. Its money is yours, and the [hatch] you climb out of stays open forever.

originStranded.name: Stranded
originStranded.desc: Start [on foot] in a random remote spot.

originCriminal.name: Criminal
originCriminal.desc: Start beside your camper, already [wanted] with a [10,000€ bounty].

originMayor.name: Mayor
originMayor.desc: Pick a [city], then begin there with [50 of every crafting material].

originDungeon.name: Dungeon entrance
originDungeon.desc: Start at the [tower gate] with a dungeon kit: [extra potions], the [tower routes map], a [flashlight] and a [climbing rope].

originLot.name: Full automation
originLot.desc: Every party member starts with [advanced crafting specializations] and a fully stocked [workshop].

originBike.name: Start on bike
originBike.desc: Begin out in the country with a [bike] parked beside you.

originCar.name: Start in car
originCar.desc: Start in the country next to your [car].

originCamper.name: Start in camper
originCamper.desc: Start in the country next to your [camper].

originSpace.name: Start in space
originSpace.desc: Skip map selection and start in [space].

originTrain.name: Start in train
originTrain.desc: Board the [train] and pick your destination on the map (default).

rerollCharacter.name: Reroll character
rerollCharacter.desc: Randomize this character again and update the dossier.

ageElder.name: Elder (60+)
ageElder.desc: Old enough to have lived through the Psychic Wars.

randomTraits.name: Randomize traits
randomTraits.desc: Have traits randomly assigned to your character.

randomClass.name: Random class
randomClass.desc: Be assigned a random starting class.

selectClass.name: Select a class
selectClass.desc: Choose your starting class from a list of archetypes.

randomizeAllParty.name: Randomize all party
randomizeAllParty.desc: Fill every party slot with a random character instantly, then choose your origin.

totalRandom.name: Total Random
totalRandom.desc: Create a completely random character instantly.

newCharacter.name: Create New Character
newCharacter.desc: Create a brand new character from scratch.

hometownPick.name: Pick on map
hometownPick.desc: Choose your hometown from the map.

combatMonsters.name: Monsters
combatMonsters.desc: Capture and battle with monsters. \C[1]This cannot be changed later.\C[0]

combatMap.name: Strategic Battle (WIP)
combatMap.desc: Tactical fights on the map grid. Weapons and skills have range, and line of sight matters. Can be changed in Options.

combatRpg.name: Turn Battle
combatRpg.desc: Standard turn-based combat. Skills cost MP/AP and are picked from your command menu.

peaceful.name: Peaceful
peaceful.desc: Enemies only attack if provoked, and you can \C[1]Talk\C[0] to them in battle. Defeat returns you to your last respawn point.

bloodAndOil.name: Blood and Oil
bloodAndOil.desc: Slashing hits can cut off body parts for good, with permanent stat penalties. Broken parts heal. Losing a vital organ kills instantly. Allies not resurrected by battle end die permanently.

permadeath.name: Permadeath
permadeath.desc: Allies not revived by the end of battle die for good. If the whole party falls, you must create a new character.

roguelite.name: Roguelite
roguelite.desc: If defeated, you wake on the dungeon base floor. Fallen allies stay in the party and can be resurrected after battle.

originCardCollector.name: Card Collector
originCardCollector.desc: You start with a shelf of [monster cards] and a ready [deck]. Anyone you meet might sit down for a game.

originArcanist.name: Arcanist
originArcanist.desc: You left the college with [four esoteric spells] apiece, a shelf of [school primers], a [beginner's grimoire] and robes that still smell of chalk. Pick where the coach sets you down.

originMercenary.name: Mercenary
originMercenary.desc: The last contract paid in kit rather than coin: a [ranged weapon] each, a [field vest], a [medic's bag] and whatever survival gear was left in the truck. Pick where the work takes you.

originLostConvoker.name: Lost Convoker
originLostConvoker.desc: The rite worked. It just did not say where. You come to in a field, a forest or a mountainside nobody chose, with [eight summoning rites] apiece, a [staff], a [robe] and no idea which country this is.

originSkeletonKey.name: Skeleton Key Holder
originSkeletonKey.desc: You own only a key that opens [any mundane lock]. Pick where on the map you start.

originPlague.name: Plague Spreader
originPlague.desc: You escaped a biolab with a case full of [sealed vials] holding the [worst pathogens] that ever existed.

originDiplomat.name: Diplomat
originDiplomat.desc: Begin in [Brussels] with an [ONU Terminal] for remote access to the assembly, and nothing else.

originExpressions.name: Expressions
originExpressions.desc: Every party member starts [Expressing], with a random power. Later recruits get one too. Start in any city.

originHypernetExplorer.name: Hypernet Explorer
originHypernetExplorer.desc: You come round at a terminal in the [Hypernet Point] with a bag of [components], an energy drink and no memory of paying for the hour. The [deck is half built]. The rest of it is out there somewhere, in shops, in skips, and in other people's houses.

originPatronVault.name: Holy Patron Bunker
originPatronVault.desc: You wake on [Floor -1] of a bunker nobody else can reach, nine cellars deep under a [hatch in open country]. The way out is the patron's own hatch, and the way in was knowing where it is.

originPatronStar.name: Holy Patron Star
originPatronStar.desc: You wake aboard your ship in [orbit of a patron's home world], a living planet round a star that burns nowhere else, thousands of light years out in the Milky Way. Only a [patron square this world already knows] can point the way there.

originCustom.name: Custom Scenario
originCustom.desc: Write your own scenario in the [editor] here: start, gear, [bounty], [army], and a role as a [member] of a faction or hyperpower, [mayor] of a town, or founder of a [party] or [faction]. Saved in the [scenarios folder]; every file there is listed here.
